issues.what: the spiral dust is softer and more brushed than the canyon terrain under it
issues.fix: break the veil into finer filaments so it matches the terrain detail

issues.what: the same brushed dust veil, with less internal structure than the ground
issues.fix: add finer filament structure inside the cyclone

issues.where: tiles D and G, bright white patch on the lower-left globe
issues.what: The patch is nearly blown out and ends in hard, detached chips. Its edge looks pasted on against the much softer surrounding surface.
issues.fix: Recover tonal detail in the whites and replace the hard chip-like edge with finer, irregular breakup that matches the surrounding surface.

issues.where: tiles F and H, lower-central globe
issues.what: The tight ochre spiral and surrounding wisps look smeared and airbrushed beside the sharply etched canyon. Fine surface detail drops away across a broad area.
issues.fix: Break up the tight spiral with irregular fine detail and retain some underlying terrain contrast through the thinner wisps.

issues.where: tiles T through V, illuminated lower limb
issues.what: A narrow pale rim sits inside a broader blue-gray glow, giving parts of the limb a double outline.
issues.fix: Blend the rim and outer glow into one continuous atmospheric falloff without losing the silhouette.

issues.where: tile S, bottom-left foreground canyon wall
issues.what: The near rock face softens into diagonal smears while the adjacent strata and rubble remain crisp.
issues.fix: Restore localized fracture and grain detail on the soft face without lifting the deep shadows.

issues.where: tile T, dense star field left of the globe
issues.what: Many of the faint stars are soft blue flecks rather than clean points, especially against the sharply defined brighter stars.
issues.fix: Tighten the faint stellar cores and keep the diffuse background texture separate from the points.
